newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products mixed, lighter ends firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, lighter ends firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday morning, with lighter products generally firming, while fuel oil sagged, dealers said.
Gasoline was about $1 a tonne firmer than at Thursday's close. Rotterdam offers were at $204.50 fob from a number of refiners: the best bid was at $204. Two fob AR barges traded at $202.

Swaps were slightly higher on the offer side and the wide June/July backwardation was reinforced with a spread deal at $5. Traders said the prospect of increased auto fuel taxes in the U.K. budget in June may open the spread even further.
